objective: Enable the existing bounded DR24 HATS batch parity test, deterministic multi-OID Workbench browser test, and bounded Zubercal DR20 ambiguity parity test on a dedicated CI branch without changing runtime code, scientific processing, or frozen baselines.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: Inspected existing DR24 and Zubercal adapters, test fixtures, source contracts and current workflow branch filters.
DR24 raw acquisition is distinct from normalized observations and inference. Source selection and provenance must remain explicit.

The DR24 API test uses two pinned OIDs and expected epoch counts and SHA-256 values. The UI test uses a deterministic fake backend. The Zubercal test performs one bounded 1.2-arcsecond query and expects the previously observed two-candidate ambiguity.

expected_improvement: Run existing bounded source and deterministic browser tests against the current main code without relying on obsolete feature branch filters.
Collect exact current-branch test results and preserve the resulting workflow evidence.
Avoid full-archive retrieval, large model downloads, production data changes, or changes to scientific acceptance criteria.

coverage.before: The three existing source/UI workflows were constrained to historical feature branch names. Current PR and branch runs did not execute these opt-in tests.
coverage.after: The workflow definitions will also accept one dedicated bounded validation branch. Actual test execution remains pending.

reproducibility.before: Pinned DR24 OID hashes, deterministic fake-browser tests, and a fixed Zubercal ambiguity test already exist, but current-branch execution was not recorded.
reproducibility.after: The same existing test contracts will run on a dedicated branch and retain their CI logs and any configured evidence artifact.

reliability.before: A skipped live test did not establish current source parity.
reliability.after: Pending exact workflow outcomes; no result is assumed.

measurement.trade_off: This adds branch-trigger coverage to three test workflows. It does not change runtime code or scientific data handling.

evidence: The dedicated branch was created from main SHA f681408fae8d8062dd72ff74791872c1590f6ee8.
No test result is claimed before the updated workflow definitions trigger and finish.
validation.blocker: Await bounded DR24 API parity, deterministic Workbench browser, and Zubercal ambiguity workflow results on the dedicated branch.

root_causes: DR24 and Zubercal workflow triggers were restricted to historical feature branch names, so current branch runs skipped the corresponding opt-in tests.
unresolved: Whether the current live DR24 HATS payloads still match the pinned epochs and SHA-256 values.
Whether the deterministic Workbench browser workflow passes with the current UI and API.
Whether the bounded Zubercal DR20 query still returns the expected two-PS1 ambiguity.

findings: Live-source tests should run on an explicit bounded validation branch rather than depend on stale feature branch names.
A live-source test pass verifies only its declared pinned source contract; it does not establish physical source identity, photometric parity, model validity, or full scientific acceptance.
The UI fake-backend test establishes deterministic interaction behavior only.

Run the deterministic multi-OID Workbench browser test.
